spans.text: [5] AR: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا EN: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.

folded.id: that we|will|never cause failure to allah upon earth
folded.subject: that we
folded.object: never cause failure to Allah upon earth

spans.text: [12] AR: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا EN: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

folded.id: the fire|of|hell
folded.subject: the fire

spans.text: And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

folded.id: the messages|of|their lord
folded.subject: the messages

spans.text: [28] AR: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا EN: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.

folded.id: the nobleness|of|our lord
folded.subject: the nobleness

spans.text: [3] AR: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا EN: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

folded.id: the remembrance|of|his lord he will put into arduous punishment
folded.subject: the remembrance
folded.object: his Lord He will put into arduous punishment

spans.text: And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.

folded.id: the servant|of|allah stood up supplicating him
folded.subject: the Servant

spans.text: [19] AR: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا EN: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

folded.id: their lord|intends|for them a right course
folded.subject: their Lord

spans.text: [10] AR: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا EN: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

folded.id: then they|will|know who is weaker in helpers and less in number
folded.subject: then they
folded.object: know who is weaker in helpers and less in number

spans.text: [24] AR: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا EN: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

folded.id: there|will|never protect me from allah anyone [if i should disobey]
folded.subject: there
folded.object: never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey]

spans.text: [22] AR: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا EN: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

folded.id: they|will|abide therein forever
folded.subject: they

spans.text: And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

folded.id: they|will|be
folded.subject: they

spans.text: [15] AR: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا EN: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

folded.id: we|would|have given them abundant provision
folded.subject: We

spans.text: [16] AR: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا EN: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

folded.id: with them|and|has enumerated all things in number
folded.subject: with them
folded.object: has enumerated all things in number

spans.text: [28] AR: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا EN: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
